'''Naporar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Naporar system/Legends|Naporar system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]] linked it to the [[Ornfra system/Legends|Ornfra]] and [[Sposia system/Legends|Sposia systems]], while the [[Chasdemonus Route]] connected it to the [[Colonial Station Cam'co system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Naporar was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to [[Nuruodo family|House Nuruodo]], one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It also served as the headquarters of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]] and held the ranking authority in all matters related to the Chiss military units known as [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Household]] and [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Colonial Phalanxes]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Naporar was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
